uncited: This method optimizes GPU compute shader kernels for volume rendering by staging shell metadata and coefficient data into groupshared memory, thereby eliminating dependent global memory loads during the inner loop evaluation.
It builds on [Compute Shader Kernel](1202-compute-shader-kernel.md) by restructuring data access patterns to improve occupancy and reduce latency for atomic orbital (AO) evaluations.
**Inputs:** A list of Gaussian-type orbital (GTO) shells, each defined by centre, cutoff, angular momentum $l$, AO count, and primitive coefficients.
A set of evaluation points (vertices or corners).
**Outputs:** Evaluated function values and gradients at the points.
**Evaluate:** Execute the inner loop using the staged groupshared memory.
